subject: Request: SCIM delta logs, SAML metadata & least-privilege evidence for Vertex Labs
messages:
From: Emily Klein <emily.klein@vertexlabs.com>
To: aditya_rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>
Cc: Vertex Labs Compliance <legal@vertexlabs.com>
Date: 2026-07-20T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Access artifacts request for SOC2 review (SCIM/SAML/RBAC)

Hi Aditya,

We are kicking off our SOC 2 readiness assessment and need to collect proof of provisioning and access controls for the Redwood integration. Specifically we need the following artifacts and a short explanation of how each is generated and protected: 

- SCIM delta logs (full attribute sync + deltas) covering the past 90 days (we'll intake as CSV or zipped logs).
- SAML metadata and assertion validation notes (current metadata XML and any known certificate rotation dates).
- RBAC role snapshot (all roles, attached privileges, and a sample of user-role assignments).
- A short statement on how least-privilege is enforced (who approves role changes, how role reviews are performed).

If possible, please include any redaction steps (PII removal) you apply to logs and whether the sync logs contain user identifiers that could be considered sensitive. Also let us know the preferred secure transfer method (SFTP / secure Box link / encrypted email) and an estimated delivery date.

We'd like to have artifacts ingested into our compliance tracker by August 3. If you anticipate any blockers, please flag them.

Thanks,
Emily Klein
Senior Compliance Manager
Vertex Labs

Attachment: SIG-AccessTemplate.xlsx
From: aditya_rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>
To: Emily Klein <emily.klein@vertexlabs.com>
Cc: naomi_feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>, rishi_malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-07-21T10:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Access artifacts request for SOC2 review (SCIM/SAML/RBAC)

Hi Emily — thanks for the clear list. We're on it. Quick notes and proposed plan: 

- Owner: Naomi (IAM ops) will produce SCIM delta logs and RBAC snapshot. Rishi will export SAML metadata and provide assertion validation notes.
- Delivery method: secure Box link (preferred) or SFTP if you require a dedicated endpoint.
- Timeline: artifacts delivered by end-of-day July 27; attestation/statement by July 28.
- Sanitation: logs will be redacted to remove full PII (email hashed where possible) and we will include a mapping file describing fields removed.

Action items for us: 
1) Naomi: collect SCIM deltas + sanitize.
2) Rishi: gather SAML metadata, cert rotation notes, and run a test validation of a recent assertion.
3) Me: prepare the least-privilege statement and an overview of role review cadence.

Emily — is Box acceptable? If you prefer SFTP, let me know host/user details and we can push via our compliance SFTP account.

Thanks,
Aditya Rao
Head of Solutions — Redwood Inference
From: naomi_feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>
To: aditya_rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>, rishi_malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-07-27T08:45:00-07:00
Subject: SCIM/RBAC artifacts: locations and redaction notes

Folks — status update for the delivery to Vertex: 

Artifacts prepared:
- scim_sync_delta_202604-202607.zip (compressed CSVs per sync run). Location: s3://redwood-compliance/vertex/2026-07-27/scim_sync_delta_202604-202607.zip
- rbac_roles_20260727.csv (columns: role_id, role_name, permission_list, sample_user_ids). Location: s3://redwood-compliance/vertex/2026-07-27/rbac_roles_20260727.csv
- saml_metadata-20260727.xml (includes current cert thumbprint and validUntil). Location: s3://redwood-compliance/vertex/2026-07-27/saml_metadata-20260727.xml

Redaction / sanitization details:
- We replaced user email addresses with salted HMACs (sha256, redaction_salt v1) in the SCIM logs. The HMAC mapping file is NOT included by default; we can provide it under an additional NDA if required.
- We removed free-text profile fields that could include PII (bio, address).
- RBAC snapshot includes sample_user_ids (hashed) and a role-to-privilege mapping; it does not include full user profiles.

Transfer method: I uploaded the artifacts to an encrypted Box folder and generated a restricted link set to expire in 14 days. I'll send the link from the compliance account once Aditya confirms.

ETA: Link + small readme with redaction notes by EOD (today).

Naomi
Sr. IAM Engineer — Redwood Inference
Attachment: (internal) scim_sanitize_notes.md
From: aditya_rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>
To: Emily Klein <emily.klein@vertexlabs.com>
Cc: naomi_feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>, rishi_malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>, Vertex Labs Compliance <legal@vertexlabs.com>
Date: 2026-07-28T16:05:00-07:00
Subject: Delivering requested IAM artifacts for Vertex Labs — Box link + attestation request

Hi Emily — delivering the artifacts requested for your SOC 2 intake. Quick summary and links below. Please confirm receipt and whether the level of redaction is acceptable for your assessment. If you need mapping to unhashed identifiers we will require a short bilateral NDA amendment (standard practice).

Delivered artifacts (Box link): https://redwood.box.com/s/vertex-iam-transfer-20260727
Files included:
- scim_sync_delta_202604-202607.zip (SCIM deltas, emails hashed; readme explains fields removed)
- rbac_roles_20260727.csv (role snapshot, privileges, sample hashed user ids)
- saml_metadata-20260727.xml (current metadata & cert thumbprints)
- SIG-AccessTemplate.xlsx (prepopulated where useful)

Least-privilege statement (summary):
- Role creation follows a documented approval flow (manager + security reviewer).
- Quarterly role review run by IAM with product owners; automated alerts for roles with broad permissions.
- Newly onboarded service accounts are scoped to minimum required permissions and short-lived tokens are used where supported.

Next steps: 
1) Please confirm that the Box transfer works and that you can download the artifacts.
2) If Vertex needs unhashed identifiers for your tester, let us know and we'll route through legal/NDAs.
3) Please sign the short attestation via DocuSign (link): https://app.docusign.com/prepare/3f7a9e-vertex-attestation — this acknowledges receipt and redaction expectations.

Happy to hop on a 20-min call if you want to walk through any of the files.

Best,
Aditya
Head of Solutions — Redwood Inference
Attachments: scim_sync_delta_202604-202607.zip; rbac_roles_20260727.csv; saml_metadata-20260727.xml
